patterns.message: note: 'purple-to-blue gradient' (AI generic style) was flagged, consider continuing with brand-specific colors instead.
note: 'generic boilerplate card' (AI default) was flagged, consider continuing with project's existing card component instead.
note: 'unpaired Inter font' (AI default typography) was flagged, consider continuing with the project's design system typography instead.
note: 'colored left-border strip' (AI default alert/card) was flagged, consider continuing with native UI patterns instead.
note: 'generic glassmorphism' (AI trend default) was flagged, consider continuing with solid semantic surfaces instead.
note: 'generic pill badge' (AI default tag) was flagged, consider continuing with the project's existing badge component instead.
note: 'gradient text (bg-clip-text text-transparent)' is an overused AI landing page trope. Prefer solid semantic typography with strong hierarchy.
note: 'transition-all' triggers layout repaints on all properties. Transition specific GPU-accelerated properties (transform, opacity) instead.
warning: 'outline-none' without a focus-visible ring breaks keyboard navigation (WCAG 2.4.7 violation). Pair with focus-visible:ring-2.
note: marketing buzzword detected in functional UI copy. Strip conversational filler and speak plainly.
note: decorative ASCII character banner detected. Keep comments concise, sentence-case, and focused on rationale.
note: procedural line-by-line comment narration detected. Describe non-obvious intent and constraints instead of restating the obvious code flow.
note: 'eyebrow micro-label' (tracked uppercase kicker above headings) is an AI template habit. Let headings carry their own weight.
note: 'hard offset shadow' (neo-brutalist block shadow) detected. Verify this matches project design language, or use subtle stepped elevation.
note: 'zero-offset glow' (neon ambient halo) is an AI aesthetic cliché. Prefer crisp 1px borders or directional elevation shadows.
note: 'ghost card' (declaring elevation twice with border + heavy shadow) detected. Choose one elevation model: a crisp 1px border OR an elevation shadow.
warning: '100vh' / 'h-screen' causes content clipping under mobile browser address bars. Use '100dvh' or 'min-h-dvh' instead.
note: fixed-width button detected. Hardcoded widths cause text clipping in non-English locales (+20% to +40% expansion). Use padding and min-width.

patterns.regex: (?:looks like you haven't|blank canvas awaiting|getting started is easy and fun|your workspace is empty)
patterns.message: note: flowery empty state copy detected. Keep empty states to 1 factual sentence plus a direct action button.
note: modal dialog enclosing simple form detected. Prefer inline progressive disclosure or dedicated route canvas over disruptive modals.
note: CSS @keyframes animation without 'prefers-reduced-motion' query detected. Provide a static or reduced motion fallback.
note: 'hover:scale-105' bounce on buttons feels gimmicky in operational UI. Use snappy micro-feedback (transition-colors or active:scale-[0.98]).
warning: hybrid neologism ('di-submit', 'meng-generate') detected. Maintain strict single-language purity (use native Indonesian terms or pure English).
note: nested card containers ('card-in-card') detected. Use flat lists, hairline dividers, or recessed well surfaces instead of nesting cards.
note: unprompted 'cream ground + terracotta accent' (Wave 3 AI editorial cliché) detected. Derive palette from project tokens or authentic material instead.
note: decorative index numbering ('01 / 02', '(001)') detected. Order sections by typography scale and content rather than performative index tags.
note: 'broadsheet cosplay' (dense hairline dividers with zero border-radius) detected. Structure layouts with spatial padding and tonal contrast.
note: performative agency metadata (geographic coordinates, fake version/scroll stamps) detected. Remove ornamental meta.
note: generic AI buzzword detected ('seamless', 'robust', 'supercharge', 'cutting-edge'). Use plain operational verbs and concrete metrics.
note: tricolon cadence detected ('Word. Word. Word.'). State the capability or outcome directly instead of using advertising triplets.
note: synthetic rebuttal cadence ('Not just a X, it\'s a Y') detected. State what the system does directly without the false dichotomy.
note: AI preamble/filler detected ('In today\'s fast-paced...', 'Built for modern teams'). Delete the introductory throat-clearing and lead with action.
warning: clumsy literal translation detected ('laci sembul', 'garis rambut'). Use natural Indonesian ('panel samping', 'garis tipis', 'area utama').
warning: numbered step card ('01', '02' inside bordered rounded card) detected. Render sequential workflows as a connected <ol> stepper instead of isolated cards.
